newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 241,000 barrels in the week ended November 6 to 11.614 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks fell by 450,000 barrels to 9.34 million barrels. Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks rose by 115,000 barrels to 5.793 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
